theme: Lazy MCP/tool catalog without lossy results

acceptance_tests: Five MCP servers with 100 tools stay below initial context budget
Lazy-selected tool with image/resource/blob result matches eager invocation settlement
Permission-filtered catalog entries show omitted/deferred/materialized receipts

theme: Malformed provider/tool turns must not poison durable history

JSON tool args followed by reasoning text recovered or rejected deterministically
